species.real: The boulders began as magma that cooled slowly underground into granite, then cracked into blocks that weather rounded off once the rock above had worn away.
species.name: Bathlet

dex.text: A boulder that went in the sea once and liked it. Rolls in at high tide and sits there looking pleased with its grotto.
dex.fact: At The Baths on Virgin Gorda, huge granite boulders tumbled together form sea-filled grottoes and pools you can scramble through.

species.real: Virgin Gorda means 'fat virgin' in Spanish, a name Columbus is said to have given because the island's skyline looked like a woman lying on her back.
species.name: Bathrock

dex.text: Houses a whole cool, bright cave in itself and rents it out to smaller friends by the afternoon. Never gets stuck in its own passages. Mostly.
dex.fact: The Baths boulders are granite, left standing as softer rock around them wore away; the shapes were not carved by people.
